issuesEn: All four quadrants used placeholder copy: 'Placeholder headline text', 'Tab One…Tab Six', 'and a second line of copy', 'One clear message'
The four backgrounds were near-identical neutral greys, making the frame dull with no hierarchy or colour rhythm
The bottom half of the browser window was empty, and tab names were cut mid-letter in the narrow tabs
The TR whip push was focused too far left, so after zooming both ends of the typed line and the caret were cropped out
The BR cursor was a white dot with a black ring, the comment card was two bold lines, and every window had the same generic shadow
changesEn: Timing is untouched (63f, 0.08/0.13 tab offsets, 0.42–0.54 push, 0.24/0.46/0.56 words, the five-step BR chain); copy is now realistic product content with the original character counts: search 'Launch notes for Atlas v2', command '$ deploy --prod --region eu', 'Plan. Ship. Grow.', reply 'Approved!'
Backgrounds now alternate diagonally: cool light grey / deep ink / accent indigo / warm light grey, each with a low-contrast gradient; the BL words are white on the accent (card updated)
The browser window gets a page skeleton (heading bar, accent button, image block); tabs use names of four characters or fewer, centred, and the last tab settles as active
The TR push focus moved to 80% and mono size went 11→10, so the end of the command line and the caret stay in frame after the push; the command card sits on the dark field with a deeper shadow

BR uses a macOS arrow cursor, the comment card has an initials avatar and 'Maya · just now', and the send icon fills in when typing finishes; all windows share hairline borders, an inner highlight and a two-layer soft shadow, with a vignette and 5% grain over the frame
